objective: Focused native pixel-shift synthesis, not a CLI clone of NX Studio

user_decisions.vendor_runtime: Wine and Nikon DLLs are research oracles only, not a product backend
user_decisions.secondary_interchange: Existing Linear DNG research is secondary to NEFX synthesis
user_decisions.public_artifacts: English only; repository text is ASCII
first_release_features: Pixel-shift synthesis for most Nikon cameras with official pixel-shift shooting; initial model set: Z8, Zf, Z6III and Z5II
NEFX output fidelity and downstream workflow compatibility
excluded_from_active_scope: General RAW rendering and other NX Studio features
A CLI clone of NX Studio

current_capabilities.inspect: Metadata and file hashes via ExifTool
current_capabilities.merge: Experimental native complete 4/8/16/32-frame Nikon Z8, Zf, Z6III or Z5II sequence to one NEFX or a complete output directory; all nine supported input/output combinations
current_capabilities.output_set_publication: Linux no-replace atomic directory publication after all outputs and the full sequence pass validation
current_capabilities.chromatic_aberration_correction: Optional native source-metadata red/blue radial correction before crop; disabled by default
current_capabilities.sequence_validation: Explicit capture order, consecutive shot numbers, consistent observed metadata, no duplicate files
current_capabilities.nefx_writer: Native packed14 RGB, Nikon metadata updates and CRCs, private preview, preserved source JPEGs, atomic no-overwrite publication
current_capabilities.dng: Secondary library/research path with raw-sample and Adobe SDK validation

historical_research: Existing Picture Control and renderer code and evidence are retained, but are not active work or synthesis release requirements.
acceptance_boundaries: Synthetic fixture and saved vendor-output agreement is not authentic capture validation.
LibRaw or Adobe SDK decoding is not Lightroom Classic acceptance.
A readable NEFX with the right samples is not byte-identical Nikon serialization.
release_gaps: Authentic complete pixel-shift sequences and matching NX Studio NEFX references for each enabled Nikon model
Downstream application acceptance of native NEFX outputs, including Lightroom
compatibility_limits: Source Adobe XMP defaults are preserved; vendor-equivalent default sharpening and noise reduction are not established. This is an appearance limitation, not evidence of different merged RAW samples.
HE/HE* decoding is unsupported. HLG, non-FX image areas, other firmware and broader correction parameters remain unvalidated.
Full-resolution resource measurements cover synthetic repeated-RAW cases, not authentic capture quality or a universal memory bound.
LibRaw 0.22.1 has no XYZ-to-camera matrix for Z5II. Native NEFX aggregation preserves source color metadata and reports the missing matrix; it does not substitute calibration or implement rendering.
deferred_work: Exact vendor Adobe-default calibration is ancillary compatibility work and does not authorize Picture Control or general renderer development.
Cross-platform packaging follows native Linux synthesis.
active_priorities: Maintain strict four-model native aggregation and per-model acceptance records in pixel-shift-camera-support.json; preserve all nine merge modes.
Validate ordered synthesis against authentic capture and matching reference files when they become available.
Resolve concrete merge, NEFX serialization or resource defects demonstrated by capture validation.
Retain experimental status until authentic capture and downstream acceptance are established.
